info.name: Retrieve List of Descendant Group IDs

params.name: groupIdentifier
params.description: ID of the group to retrieve group descendant IDs for.

params.name: depth
params.description:
Number of levels of group descendants returned. 
- depth = NULL: Returns children group IDs directly under the specified group.
- depth = 0: Returns group IDs of all groups within hierarchy. 
- depth = 1: Returns children group IDs directly under the specified group.
- depth = 2: Returns children and grandchildren group IDs for the specified group. 
- depth > maximum levels in hierarchy: Returns descendant group IDs at all depths for the specified group.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of descendant group IDs for the specified group and depth.

params.name: id
params.description:
Id of the group of interest. Either GUID or URL-Encoded version of path\to\group string depending on groupOption value.
            If not specified, response will contain all groups data for the homegroup of the user who created the API token being used on the call 
            data with or without its underlying subgroups depending on includeSubgroups value.

params.name: groupOption
params.description:
Option to retrieve groups info, either by its 'id' (GUID) or by 'path'.
            If id was not specified groupOption is ignored and data will be returned as neither id or groupOpion were specified.

params.name: includeSubgroups
params.description: Indicates whether results should include data for all subgroups of the group specified.

params.name: page
params.description:
Number of the page of group records to be returned.
            If not provided, first page of records will be returned.

params.name: limit
params.description: Indicates count of items to retrieve. By default the service will return 100 items.
